title: File:De blauwe olifant Diemen (Q95919397) - 3.jpg
desc: "The blue elephant", type of jungle gym and municipal monument in Diemen, the Netherlands. This was a common type of jungle gym in the fifties and sixties, but this is one of the few remaining pieces.
